scope: Fixed pilot of direct JSON byte encoding; not a full-goal acceptance. Profiling is excluded from timings.
order: one warmup each, then five AB/BA pairs
retention_rule: Do not retain added production complexity unless both JSON writer medians improve over previous fork with no failed correctness gate. All +25/+50 per-pair gates are still required for the overall goal.
